title: Pak1.pak
wikitext:
:''For the polish Quake player, see [[Pak1]].''
Pak1.pak is the registered Quake data file that contains the episode 2-4 levels and the deathmatch levels (dm1-6) along with the sounds and models required to play these. It also contains the bonus level [[e1m8]] that is entered from a secret portal on [[e1m4]]. Pak1.pak resides in ./Quake/id1/.
